name: mdg-cyclone-gezani-2026-openstreetmap-data
notes:
This dataset contains OpenStreetMap data exported from the HOTOSM disaster mapping response to Tropical Cyclone Gezani in early 2026 (GLIDE: [TC-2026-000015-MDG](https://www.glidenumber.net/glide/public/search/details.jsp?glide=23729&record=1&last=1) ). 

On Tuesday the 10th of February, Tropical Cyclone GEZANI 26 made landfall near the city of Toamasina on the eastern coast of Madagascar as Category 4 cyclone. The cyclone severely damaged homes leading to massive displacements, caused fatalities and injured many. 

HOT is working in collaboration with Madagascar OSM Community, Malagasy Red Cross, and INGD (Mozambique Disaster Risk Management Institute) to prioritise and coordinate the mapping response. 

The data has been contributed by volunteers through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's Tasking Manager and represents buildings and roads in the affected area. It is updated weekly as mapping progresses. Subscribe to this dataset to be notified of any new updates.

This dataset includes all OpenStreetMap features in the area of interest for this event, covering: Buildings and Roads.

See the list of projects in the Tasking Manager [here](https://tasks.hotosm.org/explore?campaign=Cyclone+Gezani+2026&omitMapResults=1&status=PUBLISHED%2CARCHIVED%2CDRAFT).

For more information see the [HOTOSM activation page](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Humanitarian_OSM_Team/Open_Mapping_Hub_Eastern_and_Southern_Africa/Cyclone_Gezani_2026).

As of 27 April 2026: over 2,000 contributors (non unique).

organization.name: hot
organization.title: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
organization.description:
**For up-to-the-minute exports from OpenStreetMap in a variety of formats for GPS and GIS, visit http://export.hotosm.org**

Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) acts as a bridge between the traditional humanitarian responders and the OpenStreetMap Community. HOT works both remotely and physically in countries to assist the collection of geographic data, usage of that information and training others in OpenStreetMap.
